trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback completed and all regions now run v2.3.0.
3. **Opened incident**: Created a SEV2 incident (INC-0001) describing the failure and the rollback mitigation, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.
